title: The Lid
text: At the terminator, where the light gives out, the ground is cut. A seam runs north and south as far as the sensors reach, dead straight, its lips raised and machined. It isn't a fault. It's a join.

lines.text: "Sefa's door. The size of a valley, she said. Her people called it the Lid."
"She said whatever burned them is under it. I took that for a figure of speech."

notes: The variant of the-door when the Enclave was found (survivors-met). Sets lid-known for the climax writer.
